name: Signup board
summary: A grid of jobs by shifts where each slot fills with a volunteer's face and you claim one with a tap.
useWhen: a group needs volunteers for shifts: move-in day, a booth, a cleanup
'who can do check-in at 10', 'sign up for a shift'
dontUseWhen: one list of things to bring (use bring-list)

roles.description: 1 to 4 jobs: label, icon (cart, clipboard, water, elevator), cap per shift 1-4, and names of group members already signed up per shift

people.description: Chat members already signed up: name, role label, shift label
